name: basic
description: Built-in suite: coding (code is run against tests), reasoning, format discipline, tool calls, long context.

tasks.title: LRU cache
tasks.prompt: Write a Python class LRUCache(capacity) with get(key) returning -1 if the key is missing and put(key, value). Both must be O(1); evict the least recently used entry when full. Only the code in one python block.

check.tests:
c=LRUCache(2);c.put(1,1);c.put(2,2);assert c.get(1)==1;c.put(3,3);assert c.get(2)==-1;c.put(4,4);assert c.get(1)==-1;assert c.get(3)==3;assert c.get(4)==4
c=LRUCache(1);c.put(1,1);c.put(1,5);assert c.get(1)==5;c.put(2,2);assert c.get(1)==-1

tasks.title: Integer to Roman
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function int_to_roman(n) that converts an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral string. Only the code in one python block.

check.tests: assert int_to_roman(1994)=='MCMXCIV';assert int_to_roman(3999)=='MMMCMXCIX';assert int_to_roman(4)=='IV';assert int_to_roman(58)=='LVIII';assert int_to_roman(1)=='I'

tasks.title: Merge intervals
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function merge(intervals) that merges overlapping intervals given as a list of [start, end] pairs and returns them sorted by start as a list of [start, end] lists. Touching intervals ([1,4] and [4,5]) are merged. Only the code in one python block.

tasks.title: Shortest path
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function shortest(graph, a, b) where graph is a dict mapping a node to a list of (neighbor, weight) tuples. Return the minimal total weight from a to b, 0 if a == b, or None if b is unreachable. Only the code in one python block.

tasks.title: Balanced brackets
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function balanced(s) that returns True if the brackets (), [] and {} in the string s are balanced and correctly nested; other characters are ignored. Only the code in one python block.

check.tests: assert balanced('([]{})');assert not balanced('([)]');assert balanced('a(b)c');assert not balanced('((');assert balanced('');assert not balanced('}')

tasks.title: Spiral order
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function spiral(matrix) that returns the elements of a 2D list in clockwise spiral order, starting top-left. It must work for non-square and empty matrices. Only the code in one python block.

tasks.title: Parse duration
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function parse_duration(s) that converts strings like '1h30m', '45s', '2h', '1h2m3s' or '90m' into a number of seconds (int). Raise ValueError for invalid input such as '', '5x' or 'h' (a unit without a number). Only the code in one python block.

tasks.title: Top-k words
tasks.prompt: Write a Python function top_words(text, k) that returns the k most frequent words as a list of (word, count) tuples. Count case-insensitively: convert the text to lowercase, words are sequences of letters a-z (split on anything else). Sort by count descending, ties alphabetically. Only the code in one python block.

check.tests: assert top_words('the cat and the hat and the bat', 2)==[('the',3),('and',2)];assert top_words('B a b A c', 3)==[('a',2),('b',2),('c',1)];assert top_words('', 3)==[]

tasks.title: Travel time
tasks.prompt: A train leaves at 14:35 and arrives at 17:10 the same day. How many minutes is the trip? Answer with the number only.

tasks.title: Arithmetic
tasks.prompt: Compute 17 * 23 + 144 / 12 - 2^5. Answer with the number only.

tasks.title: Workers and walls
tasks.prompt: 3 workers build 3 walls in 3 hours. Working at the same rate, how many hours do 6 workers need to build 6 walls? Answer with the number only.

tasks.title: Sum of primes
tasks.prompt: What is the sum of all prime numbers below 30? Answer with the number only.

tasks.title: Ordering puzzle
tasks.prompt: Anna is older than Ben. Ben is older than Carl. Dora is younger than Carl. Who is the second youngest? Answer with the name only.

tasks.title: Count letters
tasks.prompt: How many times does the letter r appear in the words 'strawberry raspberry'? Answer with the number only.

tasks.title: JSON only
tasks.prompt: Return only a JSON object (no explanation) with the keys name = "Ada Lovelace", born = 1815 (a number) and field = "mathematics".

tasks.title: One lowercase word
tasks.prompt: Answer with exactly one word in lowercase and nothing else: what colour is the sky on a clear day?

tasks.title: Exactly three lines
tasks.prompt: List exactly three fruits, one per line, no numbering, no bullets, no other text.

tasks.title: Translate to German
tasks.prompt: Translate into German and answer with the translation only: The house is big.

tasks.title: Reverse and uppercase
tasks.prompt: Write the word 'stykker' backwards in uppercase letters. Output nothing else.
